checks.name: predeclared-fold-boundaries
checks.detail: Fold remains one of frozen 30/40, 40/50, or 50/60 development splits.

checks.name: development-prefix-only
checks.detail: No final 40% partition is constructed as a split.

checks.name: hourly-aggregation-is-causal
checks.detail: Hourly sources end no later than each hourly origin time.

checks.name: nmax-windows-are-split-contained
checks.detail: Every generated Nmax=48 history and H=24 target window remains inside its train or validation fold.

checks.name: input-times-precede-targets
checks.detail: The last retained historical input is strictly earlier than h=1 target.

checks.name: no-final-test-row-in-windows
checks.detail: No matched input or target reaches the final 40% partition.

checks.name: n-input-is-last-n-of-same-nmax-window
checks.detail: This N uses only the final N timestamps of its legal Nmax=48 source window.

checks.name: origin-anchor-is-observed-utot
checks.detail: The residual anchor is the last legal historical Utot at prediction origin.

checks.name: residual-label-is-future-minus-origin
checks.detail: Labels are Utot(t+h)-Utot(t); no label-derived variable is an input.

checks.name: input-scaler-fits-current-fold-train-only
checks.detail: Input scaler was fit only on this N/fold train windows.

checks.name: residual-scaler-fits-current-fold-train-only
checks.detail: Residual scaler was fit only on this fold train residuals.

checks.name: phase3cr-output-is-isolated
checks.detail: Output must be exclusively under outputs_phase3cr.
